reflexion.title: Reflective layers reduce heat gain and glare
reflexion.body: Without such a film, energy transmission is 83%, reflection 8% and absorption 9%. If you apply a solar control film, such as LLumar R20 SR CDF, only 11% of solar energy is transmitted, while 57% is reflected and 32% absorbed.

absorption.title: Reduce heat exchange and minimize heat loss
absorption.body: Solar control films are either reflective or spectrally selective depending on design and reduce heat gain as well as disturbing glare.

uv.title: Reduce UV radiation with largely natural glass appearance
body: For applications where the transparency of the glazing should be completely preserved, special clear UV protection films such as UV Clear are available.

They are particularly suitable for museums, galleries, boutiques or shop windows where exhibits, goods and sensitive materials need protection from UV-induced fading without significantly changing the appearance of the glass surface.

einbruchschutz.title: Hold glass shards together and make rapid entry more difficult
einbruchschutz.body: The glass shards adhere to the film and are prevented from entering the interior uncontrollably. At the same time, the security film distributes the force generated by impact over a larger area of the glazing. After glass breakage, the pane therefore initially remains largely as a cohesive surface. This additional protective effect makes a complete breakthrough more difficult and can significantly delay entry through the glazing. Depending on the film system used and glass structure, tested and certified security solutions are also available that offer increased protection against forced entry.

sichtschutz.title: Light passes through, the view does not
sichtschutz.body: The frosted surface scatters the passing light in all directions. The room remains bright, the image behind dissolves — frosted glass appearance, without replacing the pane. For partitions, meeting rooms, medical offices and restroom areas.
